name: How long does it typically take to install a new gas line for a water heater?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a new gas line for a water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a new gas line for a water heater can vary depending on several factors, such as the complexity of the job, the distance from the main gas supply, and whether any permits or inspections are required. A straightforward installation might take a few hours, while more complex projects could extend to a full day. Your plumber will be able to provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, but a new gas line for a water heater can take a few hours to a full day depending on job complexity and distance from the main supply.
